observations.statement: The affected service is media-rendering in ap-southeast-1.
Render jobs remain queued longer than 15 minutes.
The incident status is investigating, and the on-call team confirmed elevated queue depth in ap-southeast-1 at 09:30Z.
Existing jobs are retained, and no data loss has been observed.
The latest published customer update was at 09:30Z.

inferences.statement: Inference: the observed elevated queue depth is consistent with the reported prolonged render-job queuing, but the sources do not establish causation.

unknowns.statement: Root cause is unknown; the incident record lists rootCause as null.
No recovery time or confirmed recovery estimate is documented.
No scope outside media-rendering in ap-southeast-1 is documented as affected or unaffected.
